_demo.purpose: Frontend development fixture based on two reference images. All people, facts, dates, and conversations are fictional.
_demo.persona: Ethan Parker, 28, a computer science PhD student at the fictional Lakeview University, living in Madison, Wisconsin.
reusable_rules: Follow the existing profile hierarchy format and dimension ID conventions.
Each fact appears exactly once in the hierarchy, and every source_ids reference must resolve.
Facts under the same attribute add distinct information. All synthetic sources are explicitly marked as fictional.
local_rules: Topic names and counts come from the legible nodes and counts in the reference images.
Leaf attributes, subtopics, and the facets used to display goals and commitments were expanded from the fictional persona for this demo; they do not define extraction rules.
Preference topics pair the object of a preference with how it is experienced, solely to create the desired number of nodes in this demo.
_demo.adaptation: For a new example, replace the topic catalog, target counts, and persona. Drop the node density and facet conventions specific to the reference images, but retain structure and reference validation.
_demo.review_state: The existing backend initially imports records as pending. Review actions are saved only to a separate demo database.

timeline_variant.purpose: Prototype data for the opening animation and timeline playback. The hierarchy and facts follow the original demo, localized into English; timestamps, scores, and source counts follow its timeline variant.
rules: The first source for each fact marks its first mention; subsequent sources represent later mentions.
support_count equals the number of sources for a fact. source_*_mean values are the averages of source confidence and importance scores.
Facts within a topic appear in groups of 1–4 at the same time, simulating several details emerging in one conversation.
Additional sources are also marked as fictional conversations.

The retained sources contain informal, fictional chat excerpts with fictional contacts and a fiction notice on the first line. Their main speaker corresponds to Ethan Parker in this localized profile.
